name: DFW Cubing Spring 2022
information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

Day 1 Events: 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Pyraminx

Day 2 Events: 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, Square-1

# ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.***

- Please review the [COVID precautions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSpring2022#17745-covid-precautions) tab for information regarding the steps taken to increase competitor safety at this competition.
- Please review the [competitor information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSpring2022#17743-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that this schedule is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.

This competition is supported by CubingUSA.
